page.title: Kestrel Porch Cam — overnight on battery

blocks.heading: kestrel-overnight — one night on battery, low-battery push, solar, and a package delivery
text: Reviewed design (Kestrel Home platform team). Services, API operations and code references come from the approved catalog and reviewed code list. The **Battery** panel is the camera's physical charge; the **Kestrel app** and **device-shadow** panels show only what the last delivered heartbeat reported, so they lag the device.
Two endings share the night: Wi-Fi up at the 8:05 AM delivery, or Wi-Fi down at the delivery (clip kept on the SD card, uploaded and pushed about 10 minutes late).

Clock times 10:30 PM, 1:10 AM, 4:00 AM, 6:50 AM and 8:05 AM are the operator's; other minutes are illustrative. Battery rates are from the HLD (about 1 %/h idle, about 1 % per clip, solar 3–4 %/h; 3.5 %/h used). The stated 4:00 AM low-battery heartbeat and the 1 %/h rate disagree (the rate would reach 20 % at about 2:30 AM), so the charge is held at 25 % until the 4:00 AM reading of 20 %. Unshown 30-minute heartbeats are illustrative.

steps.text: Thu 10:30 PM. Bedtime heartbeat: Porch Cam → router → event-ingest (`POST /heartbeats`) → device-shadow. Battery 25 %, not charging, online.

log.text: 10:30 PM cam → router → event-ingest POST /heartbeats (25 %, charging=no)

codeRefs.label: heartbeat route
codeRefs.purpose: Accepts a heartbeat and writes battery/charging to device-shadow

steps.text: Fri 1:10 AM. A raccoon crosses the porch: PIR wakes the Porch Cam and it records a ~20 s clip. Battery panel held at 25 % (see note: the 4:00 AM anchor and the 1 %/h rate disagree). The app shows the 1:00 AM heartbeat.

batt.note: held at 25 % until the 4:00 AM reading

log.text: 1:10 AM PIR motion → wake → record ~20 s clip

steps.text: 1:10 AM. Upload: `POST /events` to event-ingest and the clip to clip-store (`PUT /clips/{clipId}`). event-ingest asks motion-classifier for a label: **animal**. Saved to the timeline; event-ingest forwards only person/package, so notify-service is not called and no push is sent.

log.text: cam → event-ingest POST /events; cam → clip-store PUT /clips/{clipId}
animal → timeline only; notify-service not called

steps.text: 4:00 AM. Heartbeat reports **20 %**: event-ingest writes it to device-shadow, whose low-battery rule (≤ 20 %) marks the camera `low_battery`.

steps.text: 4:00 AM. The rule triggers one push: device-shadow → notify-service → Apple/Google push → phone: **Porch Cam battery low**. It will not repeat until the battery goes above 30 %.

steps.text: 6:50 AM. Sunrise: the solar panel starts charging the battery (physical). The app still shows the 6:30 AM heartbeat — **Not charging** — until the next heartbeat.

log.text: 6:50 AM solar panel producing power — not reported yet

steps.text: 7:00 AM. Next heartbeat carries **charging=yes**: event-ingest → device-shadow; the app now shows solar charging. Battery is still under the 30 % re-arm level, so `low_battery` stays set.

log.text: device-shadow: charging yes; low_battery stays true (≤ 30 %)

steps.text: 8:05 AM. A courier drops a package: PIR wakes the camera and it records a ~20 s clip (about 1 % of battery). The app shows the 8:00 AM heartbeat.

log.text: 8:05 AM PIR motion → record ~20 s clip (~1 %)

steps.text: 8:05 AM. Wi-Fi up: `POST /events` to event-ingest and the clip to clip-store; motion-classifier labels it **package**.

log.text: cam → event-ingest POST /events; cam → clip-store PUT /clips/{clipId}

steps.text: 8:06 AM. The resident opens the clip: the app fetches it from clip-store (`GET /clips/{clipId}`).
8:05 AM. Home Wi-Fi is down: the camera cannot reach the router, so nothing is sent. It keeps the clip on its SD card and retries every 2 minutes. The app still shows the 8:00 AM state.

log.text: 8:05 AM router unreachable → clip queued on SD card; retry every 2 min

steps.text: 8:11 AM. Retries at 8:07, 8:09 and 8:11 fail. device-shadow still shows **online**: offline needs two missed heartbeats (60 min), so the app shows the last state with an older “updated” time.

log.text: device-shadow: last heartbeat 8:00 AM — offline rule not reached (60 min)

steps.text: 8:15 AM. Wi-Fi returns about 10 minutes later. The queued clip uploads from the SD card to clip-store and the event goes to event-ingest (`POST /events`); motion-classifier labels it **package**.

log.text: 8:15 AM reconnect: cam → clip-store PUT /clips/{clipId} (queued); cam → event-ingest POST /events
